worldcombat.skill.playnice.summary: Open your hands to a foe to make peace, sapping its will to fight: lower its Attack and calm its hostility so it stops attacking for a while. The gesture spreads in a ring around you, so you must step into the crowd and be seen.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.use.0: Calm a ring of melee attackers around you
worldcombat.skill.playnice.use.1: Make a pursuer let go, then disengage
worldcombat.skill.playnice.use.2: Buy an ally time to reposition
worldcombat.skill.playnice.description.0: A calmed target loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and will not attack on its own for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.description.1: Peace radius %1$s, up to %2$s bodies at once, cast over %3$s blocks (you are the centre), giving %4$s warm motes at once.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.description.2: Opening your hands takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.preference.bo: Off opens both hands: a wider ring that calms more bodies, but each only loses the base Attack and stays calm briefly; on narrows it into a bow, calming fewer for one more Attack stage each with much longer peace, at a longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.playnice.preference.ai: The companion only considers opening its hands while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller calms only while surrounded, larger walks in to calm.
The companion only opens its hands with at least this many non-friendly bodies inside the peace radius, so the windup is not spent on one; 1 means calm whoever is there.
When on, the companion may leave its post to calm enemies under a Hold order.
